# Acknowledgement

Records that a person has acknowledged a role or entitlement in the estate

Source: [`v3/acknowledgement.json`](../../v3/acknowledgement.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/acknowledgement.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier |
| `entityType` | one of `bequest`, `executor_appointment`, `guardian_appointment`, `other` | yes | The type of entity being acknowledged |
| `entityId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Reference to the entity being acknowledged |
| `personId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Person.id of the person acknowledging |
| `personIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced person |
| `acknowledgedAt` | `string` (date-time) | yes | When the acknowledgement was given |
| `method` | one of `in_app`, `email`, `verbal`, `written`, `other` | | How the acknowledgement was communicated |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
